verdict.rationale: Productboard documents a public REST API v2 covering create, read, update, delete and search for feedback, documents, teams, analytics and product hierarchy entities. The docs include a quickstart, personal-token and OAuth authentication, cursor pagination, response field control, configuration endpoints for discovering field definitions, a Postman collection and an llms.txt index for AI consumption. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can drive the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Create, search, and manage feedback, documents, customers, and product data through Productboard's REST API.
This Quickstart walks you through your first API call using Productboard's REST API v2.
Use a personal access token to authenticate API requests. Best for internal tools, scripts, and getting started quickly.
Create, read, update, delete, and search customer feedback, complete with text content, tags, owners, source metadata, and customer attribution.
The Productboard REST API uses cursor-based pagination for all endpoints that return a list of results.
